content.rendered:
MudPuddles Toys and Books is
sponsoring Middleton Shop For Your School event starting Monday, November 13th through
Sunday, November 19th.  Mention Middleton when you are checking
out and MudPuddles will
donate 20% of your purchase to Middleton!  MudPuddles is
located at 16420 SW Langer Drive, in the Sherwood Post Office Shopping
Center.  Their hours are Monday-Saturday from 9am-7pm and Sunday
11am-5pm.  MudPuddles does FREE gift wrapping.  Thanks for supporting
our school. #LuckyMe
